notes_for_editor: Two pages say anything about this site, the register entry and the Forest Lookouts listing, and they agree on county, forest and removal. The register's coordinates (41.103392, -78.526968) and elevation (2,237 ft / 682 m) match the record's point and 681.8 m. Two searches and two page reads found no staffing, fire or site-condition evidence, so the story is short. Public access is unknown.
